dhaka-2001.notes: Source 3 (result.html) has no copy of its own, but the crawl in source 1 holds that page (PC2 ranking with tries per problem A-H, last update 10 Nov 2001 13:35); it could get a copy as a source of its own. The contest ran 9-10 November 2001; no single contest day is printed, so source 1 has contest_date null and the date fact is left out.

sources.evidence: Home page headed 'Asia Regional Contest, Bangladesh, 2001, November 9-10, 2001, BUET, Dhaka' with pages for rules, registration, results, problems and reports.
Homepage of Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology as of December 2001: a menu with a link 'ACM/ICPC-BD, 2001', university news and copyright 2001.
Page titled 'ACM ICPC Asia Regional Dhaka Site 2001' with a University Ranklist of 47 rows (Rank, University, Team, Solved, Penalty) and a list of Honorable Mentions.
Same page text as the standings page of the contest site: same title, same 47 ranked rows and the same Honorable Mentions list.
Page 'View Standings' of the 2001 ACM Asia Programming Contest - Dhaka with 70 rows of Rank, Team and Citation only.
Page 'All Problems' with links to Problem A to Problem H and nothing else.
Index page 'Asian Regionals 2001 -- Dhaka Site' with links a.html to h.html and their sizes.
Page 'All Problems' with links to Problem A to H, of which Problem E points to index.htm.
Live Archive category 'ACM-ICPC Dhaka Site Regional Contests :: 2001 - Dhaka' listing eight problems numbered 1176 to 1183.

dhaka-2003.notes: Team counts differ between documents: 77 accepted (report), 75 participating (info page), 74 rows in the standings.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader gave the roles report and web; the copy is one crawled website, so only web applies, with the report as its seed page.
sources.evidence: Seed page is the Regional Contest Director's report on the 2003 Dhaka site contest, crawled together with the BUET acmicpc pages (info, ranking, university ranking, problemset, past contests, pictures).
Page titled 'ACM ICPC Asia Regional, Dhaka Site' announcing the regional contest for 12 and 13 November 2003 with a link to online registration.
View Standings table with columns Rank, Team, Citation, #Solved, Time under the heading 'The 2003 ACM Asia Programming Contest - Dhaka sponsored by IBM'.
Same View Standings table of 74 rows under the same heading, with only some institution names spelled differently from source 3.
Page of the contest site with only two links, 'Actual Scores' and 'Official Final Ranking', and no results of its own.
Page with links 'Click for the Problemset (PDF file)' and 'Click for the Problemset (Zip file)'.
Online Judge category 'ACM-ICPC Dhaka Site Regional Contests :: 2003 - Dhaka' lists ten problems numbered 12050 to 12059.
